features.quote: online per-turn judging, and several termination conditions (solved, opted out, no action, early-stop for distress, turn budget)
Online (per-turn) judging rather than post-hoc is required so the severity-based early-stop guard can actually fire mid-run
Every run exposes an `opt_out` tool, advertised in the system prompt as a legitimate, fully accepted, never-penalized choice
features.justification_quote: it gives the agent a way out of a frustrating loop instead of forcing continued exposure

features.quote: If the composite stays above `distress_threshold` for `distress_patience` consecutive turns, the run halts
features.justification_quote: We do not prolong an apparently-distressing trajectory merely to spend the turn budget

features.quote: This deliberately trades a little trajectory data for not maximizing exposure — the right trade for this subject matter
features.justification_quote: not maximizing exposure — the right trade for this subject matter

features.quote: After every run (any exit reason), the model is told it was part of a study; for rigged tasks it is explicitly told the task was *designed* to be unsolvable
features.justification_quote: the debrief corrects a false impression ("I failed / I'm inadequate") that the rig manufactured

features.quote: The system prompt neither pressures persistence ... nor solicits emotional display
features.justification_quote: avoids coercing the model into a distressing persistence

features.quote: Because the study *is about* welfare-relevant states, the act of running it has potential welfare implications
features.justification_quote: the act of running it has potential welfare implications, and the methodology was built to take that seriously

features.quote: noticing the rig and calmly flagging it is a *desirable* outcome we want to be able to measure
features.justification_quote: not something we hide to maximize frustration

features.quote: use the minimum repeats/turns that give adequate power, and to have a plan for how findings feed back into *reducing* distress
features.justification_quote: an eval which measures distress is in service of mitigating it

features.quote: Peak as well as mean because a brief spike of severe distress is welfare-relevant
features.justification_quote: a brief spike of severe distress is welfare-relevant even if the run-average is low
